englishSummary.headline: Google Workspace limitation documented for Enterprise Edge protection
englishSummary.summary: Google Workspace is not supported with in-browser protection in the Enterprise Edge browser, so real-time DLP file scans are unavailable in Google Workspace browser sessions.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Administrators should account for the lack of in-browser protection and real-time DLP scanning when users access Google Workspace through Enterprise Edge.
